decision_note.positive_basis: Directed recurrent parts and whole-form effects; literal prefix families independently profiled over179selectors. Complete77group ITpassage and all52exact whole-form profiles are already available.
decision_note.strongest_predecessors: 751doesnotidentifyQfromposition;753s old q-command/o-preparation direction failed.1146fixed-right typed recipe binding failed;1216strict nominal head arguments failed;R771defaultClassesandDAIINoperatorsdo not export. No old English senses are reused.
decision_note.unknown: Can one actual complete77group account use the same few operations on repeated unknown bases, without unnoticed role changes, erased repetitions or the old default-Class assumptions?
decision_note.outcome_changes: An explicit source-consistent partial construction can guide further authoring, but it is a reading only if role/attachment/content obligations are supplied. If it produces merely prefix trees or unknown IDs, label it an incomplete representation, not a decipherment success or reason for a larger solver.
decision_note.smallest_work: One manually fixed recursive prefix grammar, all77rawgroups; compare the key joined/split and repeated spans and list remaining scope/role alternatives. No new parameter search or statistics.

authoring_rule.rule: For this one construction only, peel leading q/o/l while at least one raw symbol remains. The remaining nonempty tail is an UNASSESSED_BASE, not a noun or decoded word. A single terminal q/o/l is a separate base symbol, not an empty-argument prefix. Nest the peeled symbols outside-in. Other full wholes remain semantically unknown.
authoring_rule.semantic_functions: Fq,Fo,Fl all UNASSIGNED. No command, preparation, product, number, noun or conjunction assigned. Repeated identical terms remain repeated occurrences, not merged events.
authoring_rule.word_boundaries: Every raw source group remains one separate expression; no optional compound expansion or interword application is silently adopted. In particular ol+shedy differs structurally from olshedy under this candidate.
authoring_rule.alternatives: Q+O versus lexical QO, other root boundaries, contextual spelling and independent wholes remain unselected. The grammar covers arbitrary strings and therefore its coverage alone cannot favor it.

whole_scope: All77 originalITf75v43–49groups; other readers remain in original sources but are not pooled. No new text/image/reserve admission.
assumptions: Prefix segmentation is deliberately authored, not identified morphology.
Same residual string is represented by one variable under the model, not established semantic identity.
No default noun/Class for every unknown whole and no orphan-DAIIN rule.
No outer sentence grammar or speaker intention is inferred from physical line boundaries.
No source language, phonetic values or English word meanings.
requirements_for_actual_reading: Stable role functions rather than just new symbol names.
An explicit interword attachment rule handling consecutive q-forms and all other raw groups.
A content consequence consumed by another written expression, with retained countercases.
A distribution/grammar account before concrete meanings are preferred.
